claims.disproof_condition: Lower substitutability when another US/allied merchant NdPr metal or NdFeB alloy-flake producer reaches commercial scale (watch e-VAC US plant scope, USA Rare Earth, and any DoW-funded alloy capacity); this layer's scarcity claim is time-stamped to the Q2 2026 10-Q.
claims.statement: The metal-reduction and alloy layer (NdPr oxide → NdPr metal via electrowinning; strip casting → NdFeB alloy flake) exists in the US at MP's Independence Facility, commissioned late 2024 (electrowinning) and 2025 (strip casting), making Independence a fully integrated metal, alloy, and magnet plant. For US-domiciled sourcing this layer's substitutability is judged 4/5: MP self-reports the only integrated US mine-to-magnet chain and no other US merchant NdFeB alloy-flake producer is evidenced in this RA; globally the layer is China-dominated. Honest gap: ex-China merchant alloy suppliers (e.g., European or Japanese alloy makers) were not surveyed here — the 4/5 is scoped to US domestic integration, mirroring the [366] MP magnet-edge scope.

sources.quote: In late 2024, we commissioned electrowinning capabilities at the Independence Facility to produce NdPr metal from NdPr oxide. Additionally, in 2025, we added strip casting capabilities to produce NdFeB alloy flake, a key precursor product that is utilized as the material feedstock for magnet manufacturing.
the Independence Facility, a fully integrated metal, alloy, and magnet manufacturing plant
